Requirements summary / acceptance criteria:

- Summarization: concise ticket wrap-up (<50 tokens) with configurable templates per vertical.
- Quality: suggestion F1 >= 0.78 on internal eval set (tickets).
- Reliability: failover to lower-cost model variant with graceful degradation; multi-region routing (NA/EU/APAC).

- Must support SSO via Okta (SAML) and SCIM provisioning.
- KMS integration required for customer keys; retention controls to purge PII per region.
